text:
alex: Quick question — my parental leave ends May 3 and I plan to split the first 8 weeks between SF and London (family reasons). What do I need to start now for payroll/location, benefits continuity, childcare subsidy, and on-call coverage? Don’t want surprises.

sara-people-ops: Congrats, alex! :tada: Short checklist to start: LOA end confirmation, international location update, payroll change request, benefits enrollment window, subsidy pre-approval if eligible. Link to forms: https://hr.redwood.example/return-checklist (internal).

alex: thanks — is there a different process for short international splits vs a permanent transfer?

oliver-payroll: Short splits are treated differently than transfers — we coordinate with local payroll vendor and tax team. Key things: tax residency risk, dual-payroll timing, and expense coding. Submit the payroll change request at least 2 pay cycles before the first move date.

payroll-bot: FYI — payroll deadlines: submit changes by EOD on the 10th for the next cycle. Missing that may delay stipend or local payroll setup.

amira-manager: For on-call, we should plan a 2-week overlap with a buddy handoff. @alex who do you want as primary backup? I can cover critical escalation weeks 2–4.

alex: thanks amira — could you be backup for weeks 2–4? I’ll ask devex to cover week 1 and split week 5.

becca: A couple of questions on the childcare subsidy — is it prorated for partial months when you’re abroad? And do we need daycare receipts or can we register an approved provider ahead of time?

sara-people-ops: Childcare subsidy policy: prorated by calendar days for partial months, yes. We require either a signed enrollment agreement or receipts depending on timing. Quick application steps:```1) Apply for subsidy in the HR portal (choose "temporary split-location" option)2) Upload enrollment agreement OR submit receipts after service starts3) People Ops approves and payroll applies stipend to next payroll cycle```

alex: perfect. For the LOA end date, do I need manager sign-off or legal?

leave-bot: LOA policy reminder: manager confirmation + People Ops approval required for return-to-work schedule. If returning to a different country even temporarily, legal review may be triggered.

oliver-payroll: @alex please open a ticket with dates, home addresses while abroad, and whether you’ll be paid in USD or GBP for those weeks. We’ll run a quick tax check and confirm if we need to withhold differently.

alex: will do. Anything else I should watch for?

sara-people-ops: Double-check that your benefits provider accepts temporary foreign addresses (most do for short windows). If you have company equipment, coordinate shipping/insurance with eng-ops. And thanks for planning on-call coverage early — huge help. :heart:

amira-manager: Thanks — I’ll draft a short handoff doc and slack availability windows.

alex: thanks everyone — I’ll submit the payroll/change forms today and ping when ticket is up.
